notes:
2026-09-14: Islandcycling {2} is now real, structured, engine-piloted (ENGINE_GAPS.md gap #23, closed 2026-09-14) — same mechanism as Cloudbound Moogle's Plainscycling (see that card's own progress.json note), scoped to Island. scenarios.ts now runEngineScenarios (2 real engine-piloted scenarios). isIceFlanTutorFact/isIceFlanDiscardSelfWant verify-synergy.mjs exemptions REMOVED (real trace evidence now exists instead). vitest 550/550, verify-synergy.mjs 320 checked/0 hard failures, tsc no new errors.

Migrated to the unified Fact/annotations model (2026-09-12). Baseline `self-cast`/`self-enters` added (typeLine-anchored, 'Creature' — Elemental Ooze). Real ETB effect split into two facts per its own two sentences: `{event:'tap', controller:'opp', target:{types:{hasAny:['Artifact','Creature']}}, targeted:true}` and `{event:'putCounter', counterType:'stun', controller:'opp', target:{types:{hasAny:['Artifact','Creature']}}, targeted:true}` (broadened from the old single `has:['Creature']`-only fact to the full disjunctive oracle scope — the engine's own `definition.ts` still narrows to `validType:'creature'` only, a documented, unrelated engine gap: no `tapTarget`/`putCounterTarget` validType covers an artifact-or-creature union). Sink (target precondition) broadened the same way, `to:'Battlefield'` (was legacy `zone`). Islandcycling modeled as two new facts, mirroring Cloudbound Moogle's Plainscycling exactly: SINK `{event:'discard', target:'self'}` (the discard-as-cost act) and SOURCE `{to:'Hand', from:'Library', types:{has:['Island']}}` (the tutor), both zero-trace-evidence (Islandcycling lives only as `staticAbilities` text, never a resolvable Effect) — covered by two new verify-synergy.mjs exemptions (`isIceFlanDiscardSelfWant`/`isIceFlanTutorFact`, same per-card-scoped shape as their Cloudbound Moogle counterparts). No separate scenario for Islandcycling (matches Cloudbound Moogle precedent — it's fundamentally unmodelable via any Effect, not a 'consolidate into one scenario' case). Scenarios themselves converted from top-level `trigger:'onEnter'` to no-top-level-trigger + `sequence:['onEnter']` (same dwarven-castle-guard/cloudbound-moogle consolidation, 2026-09-11 precedent) so the baseline self-cast/self-enters facts get real `fn:'cast'`/`fn:'enters'` trace evidence instead of relying on an exemption. Added to scripts/annotation-coverage.mjs's ANNOTATED_CARD_SLUGS. verify-synergy.mjs: 0 hard failures (scoped + full pool — the only other pool failures present, cargo-ship/cecil-dark-knight/dragoon-s-wyvern/il-mheg-pixie/stiltzkin-moogle-merchant/the-wind-crystal/white-auracite/zack-fair, are pre-existing, from concurrent in-flight migrations by other sessions, unrelated to this card). vitest run functional-model: 238/238 unchanged. find-synergies.mjs before/after (isolated via `git stash` scoped to just this card's own files): before 0 real interaction lines (old schema's narrow opp-controller-scoped facts matched nothing pool-wide, a real pre-existing gap, not a regression); after 142 (140 unconstrained-battlefield-presence 'enters the battlefield' matches, same pool-wide pattern every other newly-migrated baseline self-enters fact produces, + 2 real 'tutor' matches — Nibelheim Aflame, The Water Crystal — the same 2 cards Cloudbound Moogle's own Plains tutor already matches, confirming the Island tutor fact works identically). The tap/putCounter(stun)/target-precondition-sink/discard-self facts still produce 0 matches — real, documented gaps (no other pool card sources a literal `discard` event or wants a `tap`/`putCounter:stun` producer yet), not fabricated.
knownGaps: definition.ts's own ETB effect narrows 'artifact or creature' to validType:'creature' only — no tapTarget/putCounterTarget validType covers that disjunction (same gap Ice Flan's own definition.ts comment already documents); the Fact model itself is NOT narrowed this way (uses types:{hasAny:['Artifact','Creature']}) since a Fact should describe the real oracle scope even where engine execution is narrower.
